methodology: Syntactic source index with bounded lexical masking of comments, string/template text and expression-position regex literals; not a complete TypeScript parser or type checker. ORM calls require schema-model receivers or inspected model aliases. Direct call sites count source locations, not executions or SQL statements. Transaction boundaries are counted separately. first/rows/changed SQL wrappers are separately indexed; do not add wrappers to direct sites to infer query count. Reachability, branch counts and query plans require workflow review/runtime evidence. No node_modules, tests, scripts or generated client included.
